title: 第7章 传说有个骑士王第8章 事件的处理
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 第7章传说有个骑士王
虽然并没有激动的感觉，但能够稳定的继续当吟游诗人，做自己想做的事。这么想着，然后她就答应了……
一路跟随，收益波动大，但是包吃包住。
这样的雇佣条件实在算不上优厚，甚至还有赌注的嫌疑，但这至少比现在穷困潦倒还不知道做什么强。
唐的出现给了姆莉一个明确的方向，哪怕这不是她选择的方向，至少暂时脱离了不知所措的状态。
走出酒馆，在跟唐回家的途中，姆莉也逐渐冷静下来，很快拿出纸笔准备开始吟游诗人记录故事的工作。
“唐，既然你要我记录并改编你的故事，那我就要问清一些问题了，你可不能嫌烦，还要认真回答。”姆莉提笔紧紧跟在唐的身后道。
“没问题，知无不言，言无不尽，伟大的骑士不屑于说谎。”唐骄傲地拍着胸口，纸壳、铁皮与手掌碰撞在一起，发出了聒噪的动静。
“第一个问题，你为什么想要成为骑士？”
“更正，是最伟大的骑士！原因是——我想这么做！”
刚准备动笔记录的姆莉突然顿笔，终究没有写下去。
这算什么回答？可是，唐好像是认真的……算了。
“换个问题，成为最伟大的骑士需要什么条件？”姆莉换了个问题。
“要贵族册封，要大师铸造的装备，要充满传奇色彩的坐骑比如巨龙，要有随从与同伴，要有恋人，还有强大的对手！”
“听起来还算靠谱，就是有些太势利了。”姆莉将这一问一答记录在了纸上。
“下一个问题，你当时与人贩战斗的时候喊了很多招式，你不会感觉羞耻吗？”
“招式喊得越大声越有气势，气势越强技能的威力就越大，这是常识呀。”唐的语气非常自信。
姆莉听后不禁撇嘴，心想：有这个常识吗？她怎么不知道？
不过还是记在了纸上。
“下一个，你当时喊的伊艾克丝咖喱棒是什么？”
“这就说来话长了。”唐放慢了脚步，四十五度抬头仰望天空，似乎在回忆着什么。
“没关系，我不介意，请说。”姆莉认真道。
唐清了下嗓子，说道：
“传说有个马宝国，有个国王不得了，每个骑士得她指导，才懂得骑士八大美德……
“为了对抗魔王，圣女贞德带领群众奋起反击，一路击败堕落十二圆桌骑士、七大原罪魔神、四大天王、两大护法，最后献出生命封印了魔王。
“但封印所限将至，魔王已经复苏暗中计划卷土重来，而我继承了他们的意志，决心消灭魔王成为最伟大的骑士！”
听入迷了，姆莉这才想起自己还未动笔记录，可惜中间忘了，只记得开头与结尾。
于是就这么草率记下，所幸问题不大，大意传达到了。
“我还是头一次听说这个事，所以魔王真的存在吗？”姆莉困惑地看着唐。
“我相信魔王是一定存在的。”
“哦……嗯？”姆莉忽然反应过来了。
你相信？一定？意思就是不确定呗～刚刚说的都是胡编乱造吧？
content_en:
Chapter 7 Legend has it that there is a King of Knights
Although I don’t feel excited, I can continue to be a bard stably and do what I want to do. Thinking this way, she agreed...
If you follow along, your income will fluctuate greatly, but food and housing are included.
Such employment conditions are not really generous, and are even suspected of being a bet, but at least they are better than being poor and not knowing what to do now.
Tang's appearance gave Muli a clear direction. Even if it was not the direction she chose, at least she was temporarily out of the state of being overwhelmed.
After walking out of the tavern and on the way home with Tang, Mli gradually calmed down and quickly took out a pen and paper to start the bard's work of recording stories.
"Tang, since you want me to record and adapt your story, I'm going to ask some questions. Don't be irritated, but answer them seriously." Muli picked up her pen and followed Tang closely.
"No problem, tell me everything you know, and tell me everything. A great knight doesn't bother to lie." Tang proudly patted his chest, and the paper shell, iron sheet and palm collided together, making a noisy sound.
"First question, why do you want to become a knight?"
"Correction, the greatest knight! The reason is - I want to do this!"
Muli, who was just about to start writing, suddenly paused and did not finish writing.
What kind of answer is this? However, Tang seems to be serious... forget it.
"Change the question, what are the requirements to become the greatest knight?" Mli changed the question.
"You need to be canonized by a noble, you need equipment forged by a master, you need a legendary mount such as a dragon, you need followers and companions, you need a lover, and you need a powerful opponent!"
"It sounds pretty reliable, but a little too snobbish." Muli recorded the questions and answers on paper.
"Next question, you shouted a lot of moves when you were fighting the traffickers. Don't you feel ashamed?"
"The louder the move is, the more powerful it will be. The stronger the momentum, the more powerful the skill will be. This is common sense." Tang said in a very confident tone.
After hearing this, Muli couldn't help curling her lips and thinking: Is this common sense? Why didn't she know?
But I still wrote it down on paper.
"Next, what was the Ix curry stick you called?"
"It's a long story." Tang slowed down and looked up at the sky at a forty-five degree angle, as if he was remembering something.
"It's okay, I don't mind, please tell me." Muli said seriously.
Tang cleared his throat and said:
"Legend has it that there is a kingdom of horses and a great king. Each knight needs her guidance to understand the eight virtues of knighthood...
"In order to fight against the Demon King, Joan of Arc led the crowd to fight back, defeating the twelve fallen Knights of the Round Table, the seven demons of original sin, the four heavenly kings, and the two guardians, and finally gave up her life to seal the Demon King.
"But the limit of the seal is approaching. The Demon King has resurrected and secretly plans to come back. I have inherited their will and am determined to destroy the Demon King and become the greatest knight!"
Fascinated by what she heard, Muli then remembered that she had not yet written down the record, but unfortunately she had forgotten the middle and only remembered the beginning and the end.
So I jotted it down hastily. Fortunately, it wasn't a big problem and the main idea was conveyed.
"This is the first time I've heard of this, so does the Demon King really exist?" Muli looked at Tang in confusion.
"I believe that the devil must exist."
"Oh...huh?" Muli suddenly reacted.
Do you believe it? must? I mean I’m not sure. What I just said are all nonsense, right?
